skill.name: facebook-adspy-facebook-ad-library
skill.description: Use PipiAds to search Facebook ads and Meta Ad Library records, inspect creative details, and review store advertising trends.
skill.summary: Compare Facebook ads, advertisers, and store activity in PipiAds.
skill.author: pipiads-dev

security_audit.summary: The backticks format Markdown, and most secret and URL matches are declarations or documentation. The configuration passes the API key to a globally installed MCP server, and the setup directs users to an unverified separate domain for billing. Broad searches can consume paid credits; no evidence of credential theft or prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: The MCP server process receives the PipiAds API key.
remediation.suggestion: Use the host secret manager and pass only the PipiAds key to the reviewed server process. Keep the key out of prompts, files, and logs.

remediation.issue: Setup requests a global npm installation.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before installation. Verify the publisher and package integrity, review dependencies and install scripts, and prefer an isolated runtime.

remediation.issue: Key and billing setup links to a separate domain without evidence of common ownership in the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Direct users to the key and billing portal from the verified vendor homepage. Document any required cross-domain redirect.

remediation.issue: The workflow discloses per-result charges but defines no spending cap.
remediation.suggestion: Use a bounded result count and track paid detail requests. Ask for approval before exceeding the agreed credit budget.

content.user_title: Research Facebook Ads and Meta Ad Library Results
content.value_statement: It can be difficult to compare ads across advertisers, regions, and data sources. Use PipiAds to find Facebook ad examples, inspect selected records, and review store advertising activity.
actual_capabilities: Search Facebook ads by keyword and narrow results by region, advertiser, or active days.
Retrieve ad details to compare creative formats, offers, and landing pages when available.
Search for advertised products and advertisers and retrieve their details.
Search Meta Ad Library ads and products and inspect individual records.
Review store ad trends, delivery, longest-running ads, most-used ads, and Facebook advertiser pages.
limitations: Requires a configured PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key.
Searches use credits per result, and detail requests may use additional credits.
Supports one-time Facebook research, not ongoing monitoring, TikTok Shop analytics, or organic TikTok research.
Ad run length and repeated use do not prove revenue or profitability.

use_cases.title: Collect Creative References
use_cases.description: Find Facebook ads for one product and region. Compare the creative formats, offers, and landing pages of selected ads.

use_cases.title: Compare Advertised Products
use_cases.description: Find advertised products in a category. Review product and advertiser records to understand how sellers present competing offers.

use_cases.title: Review Competitor Store Activity
use_cases.description: Review ad activity for a named store. Identify its Facebook pages and compare its longest-running and most-used ads.

prompt_templates.title: Find Facebook Ad Examples
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Start with one keyword and region.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to five Facebook ads for [keyword] in [region] using PipiAds ad search. List the advertiser and main offer for each result.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Ad Library Record
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review a specific Meta Ad Library result.
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the Meta Ad Library record for [record ID]. Summarize its creative format, offer, and landing page when available. Mark any missing fields.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Advertisers
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Compare ad examples under the same filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to three Facebook ads per advertiser for [advertiser A] and [advertiser B] in [region]. Compare the offers and creative formats using the same filters. Ask before retrieving paid detail records.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Store Advertising Activity
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Combine store trends with ad-level observations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Meta Ad Library trends and delivery for [store]. Compare its longest-running and most-used ads. Separate observations from hypotheses and ask before exceeding [credit budget].

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Compare two Facebook ads for insulated bottles in Canada.
output: Ad A uses a short demonstration and offers free shipping.
Ad B uses a product carousel and offers a two-bottle bundle.
The landing page for Ad B was not available in the returned record.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Summarize the longest-running and most-used ads for a store.
output: The longest-running ad shows how the product works.
The most-used ad promotes a bundle across several creatives.
Run length and repeated use do not show which ad generated more sales.

best_practices: Specify the data source, region, keyword or advertiser, and result limit before searching.
Open detail records only for selected results. Agree on a credit budget before expanding the search.
Configure the API key through the host's secure settings. Keep it out of prompts and shared documents.
anti_patterns: Starting a broad search without a region or result limit.
Treating ad duration or frequency as proof of sales or return on ad spend.
Using a one-time research workflow for continuous monitoring.

faq.question: What do I need to connect?
faq.answer: You need the PipiAds MCP server and a PipiAds API key. Verify the package and billing portal before setup.

faq.question: Can I search both PipiAds and Meta Ad Library data?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill provides separate PipiAds tools for Facebook ad research and Meta Ad Library records.

faq.question: How are credits charged?
faq.answer: Searches cost one credit per result. A detail request costs one credit, but the same detail is free to request again within three days.

faq.question: Can I use this skill for ongoing monitoring?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for one-time research and does not provide monitoring workflows.

faq.question: Can I research TikTok Shop with this skill?
faq.answer: No. This skill covers Facebook ads and Meta Ad Library records, not TikTok Shop or organic TikTok content.

faq.question: Can the results tell me which ad earned the most?
faq.answer: No. The skill can show signals such as run length and repeated use, but those signals do not establish revenue.
